{"consolidated_memory":"## Empty Result Set in search/query/rewriter.ts — Seven Separate Incidents

**Location & Context**: All incidents occurred in search/query/rewriter.ts on the search side. Stack is TypeScript. Covering tests are in search/query/rewriter.test.ts. Same corner of code across all incidents; context carried over between fixes.

**Common Symptom Across All Incidents**: Rewritten query with no clauses left.

**Common Repro Across All Incidents**: Search for a two word phrase with a stop word.

---

### Incident 1: [2026-02-14] — Unbounded Retry Loop (c007-e0)
- **Trigger**: Deeply nested inputs beyond six levels
- **Root Cause**: Unbounded retry loop with no backoff
- **Fix**: Capped the attempts and added exponential backoff with jitter
- **PR**: #1091, branch fix/empty-result-set-1
- **Result**: Error rate dropped from 8.8% to under 6 per 10,000

### Incident 2: [2026-03-21] — Naive/Aware Datetime Mismatch (c007-e1)
- **Trigger**: Records carrying non-ASCII names
- **Root Cause**: Naive datetime compared against an aware one
- **Fix**: Made every boundary timezone aware at the edge
- **PR**: #3101, branch fix/empty-result-set-2
- **Result**: Throughput rose 42% to 37 requests per second

### Incident 3: [2026-04-08] — N+1 Query in Lazy Relation (c007-e2)
- **Trigger**: Clients still pinned to the v1 SDK
- **Root Cause**: N+1 query hidden behind a lazy relation
- **Fix**: Prefetched the relation in a single query
- **PR**: #4833, branch fix/empty-result-set-3
- **Result**: 66 duplicate rows a day stopped being written

### Incident 4: [2026-06-23] — Listener Never Removed (c007-e4)
- **Trigger**: Jobs scheduled across the midnight boundary
- **Root Cause**: Listener registered but never removed
- **Fix**: Removed the listener on teardown and asserted it in a test
- **PR**: #5110, branch fix/empty-result-set-5
- **Result**: Nightly rollup matched source counts for 96 days running

### Incident 5: [2026-07-20] — Error Swallowed by Bare Except (c007-e5)
- **Trigger**: Payloads above roughly two megabytes
- **Root Cause**: Error swallowed by a bare except
- **Fix**: Narrowed the handler and let the failure propagate
- **PR**: #6840, branch fix/empty-result-set-6
- **Result**: Alert stayed quiet for 5 consecutive days

### Incident 6: [2026-08-19] — Off-by-One in Slice Bound (c007-e6)
- **Trigger**: After a rolling restart of the fleet
- **Root Cause**: Off-by-one in the slice bound
- **Fix**: Corrected the bound and added a property test around it
- **PR**: #6927, branch fix/empty-result-set-7
- **Result**: Reclaimed 41 GB of blob storage

### Incident 7: [2026-08-20] — Race in Lazy Initialization (c007-e7)
- **Trigger**: When two requests raced on the same key
- **Root Cause**: Race in lazy initialization
- **Fix**: Guarded the init with a double-checked lock
- **PR**: #8507, branch fix/empty-result-set-8
- **Result**: Cold start dropped 16% to 815 ms"}
